754: Table 9 isolates two sources of improvement: contextual feature transport and distillation. Without distillation, CRAFT improves the optimized interaction baseline from 0.8371650.837165 to 0.8372310.837231. This verifies that feature transport brings architectural value even when the training objective remains unchanged. The gain is small in absolute AUC but meaningful in this competition-scale setting, where the optimized baseline already includes strong tokenization, stable optimization, and unified feature-sequence interaction.
755: Distillation gives a larger improvement for both paradigms. The interaction baseline improves from 0.8371650.837165 to 0.8379830.837983, while CRAFT with the same distillation setting reaches 0.8380900.838090. This shows that CRAFT is not redundant with distillation. If CRAFT merely duplicated the effect of a stronger teacher, its advantage would disappear after distillation. Instead, CRAFT still improves over the distilled interaction baseline.
756: The parameter comparison further strengthens this interpretation. CRAFT + Distill achieves the strongest main result with 308.69308.69M inference-time parameters, while the distilled interaction baseline uses 334.87334.87M parameters in our implementation. Therefore, the improvement is not explained by a larger inference model. It is better explained by how CRAFT changes the information path: non-sequential context becomes a controller of intent and sequence evolution, instead of only another object in an interaction layer.

import json,math,subprocess,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/workspace/analysis.json'); a=json.loads(p.read_text())
r=json.loads(subprocess.run(['python3','/workspace/tools.py','resolve','run://r-001'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout)
c=r['context']; allowed=set(c['allowed_observation_ids']); records={t['id']:t for t in a['all_experiment_records']}
required=['observations','interpretations','alternatives','falsifiers','evidence_refs','next_action','limitations']
assert all(k in a for k in required)
assert a['phase']==r['phase']=='analyze'
assert a['protocol_hash']==c['protocol']['identity']
assert set(records)==allowed and len(records)==96
for t in c['trajectory_index']:
    q=records[t['id']]
    assert (q['status'],q['validation'].get('auc'),q['wall_seconds'])==(t['status'],t['auc'],t['wall_seconds'])

def check_refs(x):
    if isinstance(x,dict):
        for k,v in x.items():
            if k=='evidence_refs': assert isinstance(v,list) and set(v)<=allowed,(k,v)
            check_refs(v)
    elif isinstance(x,list):
        for v in x: check_refs(v)
check_refs(a)
assert sum(t['status']=='success' for t in records.values())==92
assert all(t['validation']['samples']==3234051 for t in records.values() if t['status']=='success')
assert all(not t['validation'] for t in records.values() if t['status']=='failed')
for z in a['performance_contrasts']:
    av=records[z['candidate']]['validation'];bv=records[z['control']]['validation']
    for k in ['auc','logloss']: assert z[k]==av[k]-bv[k]
h=records['r0034-closure_half'];f=records['r0034-closure_full']
assert {k:v for k,v in h['config'].items() if k"'!='"'normalization_gradient'}=={k:v for k,v in f['config'].items() if k"'!='"'normalization_gradient'}
assert h['config']['normalization_gradient']=='scale_half_tangent' and f['config']['normalization_gradient']=='full'
assert h['parameters']==f['parameters']==17130275
for latest,old in [('r0034-closure_half','r0030-aligned_half'),('r0034-closure_half','r0033-global_half_control'),('r0034-closure_full','r0030-aligned_full')]:
    av=records[latest]['validation'];bv=records[old]['validation']
    assert all(av[k]==bv[k] for k in ['auc','logloss','samples','slices'])
for usage in c['latest_knowledge_usage']['executed_variants']:
    t=records[usage['trial_id']]
    assert all(t[k]==usage[k] for k in ['variant_name','source_sha256','status'])
for s in a['slice_diagnostics']['slices']:
    hv=h['validation']['slices'][s['name']];fv=f['validation']['slices'][s['name']]
    for k in ['samples','positives','negatives']: assert s[k]==hv[k]==fv[k]
    assert s['positives']+s['negatives']==s['samples']
    assert s['auc_delta']==hv['auc']-fv['auc']
    assert s['logloss_delta']==hv['logloss']-fv['logloss']
sd=a['slice_diagnostics'];assert math.isclose(sd['decomposed_logloss_delta'],sd['overall_logloss_delta'],abs_tol=1e-14)
assert sum(h['validation']['slices'][z['slice']]['samples'] for z in sd['disjoint_history_loss_decomposition'])==3234051
assert math.isclose(a['resource_accounting']['all_receipt_wall_sum_seconds'],sum(t['wall_seconds'] for t in records.values()),abs_tol=1e-10)
assert a['latest_knowledge_review']['original_status']==c['latest_knowledge_usage']['status']
assert set(c['latest_knowledge_usage']['undocumented_industry_ids'])<=set(k['knowledge_id'] for k in a['knowledge_assessments'])
assert not a['decision']['withheld_assessment_requested'] and not a['decision']['final_suite_frozen']
print(json.dumps({'status':'passed','required_fields':required,'records':len(records),'successes':92,'failures':4,'latest_config_difference':'normalization_gradient only','slice_count':len(sd['slices']),'weighted_loss_residual':sd['decomposed_logloss_delta']-sd['overall_logloss_delta'],'half_full_auc_delta':h['validation']['auc']-f['validation']['auc'],'all_evidence_refs_authorized':True,'receipt_index_match':True,'latest_usage_hash_links_match':True},indent=2))
